title: Chapter 7158: Shut Up

Chapter 7158: Shut Up

Chapter 7158: Shut Up

“Surprised?” Skykiller True Dragon was the source of the illusory voice.

“Not quite.” Li Qiye smiled and shook his head.

“Why?” Skykiller didn’t expect this answer.

“You, are not him, but you wish to become him.” Li Qiye said.

Skykiller didn’t know how Li Qiye figured it out.

“The key was Royal Bloodlines.” Li Qiye said.

“Am I not similar?” Skykiller asked.

“Yes, but you couldn’t solve Royal Bloodlines, you never will.” Li Qiye said.

“Don’t be so sure.” Skykiller said.

“Do you know what’s the most pitiful thing?” Li Qiye asked.

“What?” Skykiller’s expression changed.

“What you’re searching for has been near you the entire time, yet you didn’t have a clue.” Li Qiye said: “And you ended up carving the person you love the most to prosper your race. I suppose Skykiller is even more pitiful, that you chose the race and not him.”

“It is our responsibility.” Skykiller said.

“Being abandoned must be an unbearable pain.” Li Qiye sighed.

Skykiller had a chilling expression.

“He didn’t let go and waited for you to let go, so that you two would be able to move forward together.” Li Qiye lamented.

“Shut up!” Skykiller staggered backward.

“Then you decided to carve him up and use his corpse as a reproduction pond, is there a more tragic tale?” Li Qiye naturally didn’t obey.

“I never did!” Skykiller shouted.

“Sure, you didn’t do it when he was alive but he knew. Eventually, he couldn’t wait any longer and let go of everything including his corpse and soul for a battle against the high heaven.” Li Qiye continued: “You used what he left behind, hence the hybrids. Alas, the hybrids couldn’t preserve the original bloodlines, they were weaker, each inferior to the last. Although they reproduced easily, they couldn’t reach atavism.”

“And?” Skykiller calmed down.

“Later on, you realized the key was Royal Bloodlines. As long as you could unlock it, you could have what you were searching for. Thus, you wanted to find him to figure out the truth, hence the appearance of Hidden Order.” Li Qiye said: “Unfortunately, despite having the same ability to let go as he did, you didn’t dare to face him.”

“...” Skykiller didn’t respond.

“So you came up with another plan, using the remnant soul and true fate and through rebirth, you became him to use Royal Bloodlines.”

“Rebirth?” Listeners stared at Skykiller.

At the start, they didn’t quite understand what was going on. However, the word “rebirth” instantly illuminated their minds.

“He’s not His Majesty...” An immortal said.

“Then who is it?” An overlord didn’t grasp the issue.

“He’s... no, that’s Phoenix Queen...” The immortal responded to the crowd’s astonishment.

This Skykiller True Dragon was identical to their ruler, whether it be his aura or expression. Those who had seen him didn’t doubt the resemblance.

Her Majesty, Phoenix Queen, had passed away before Skykiller True Dragon. Thus, reality betrayed logic.

“I was curious about why Skykiller True Dragon needed a different gift rather than the innate one. Could Skykiller at the apex level be stronger than Royal Bloodlines?” Li Qiye elaborated: “But once Xiaoyue handed me the bottle of blood, I understood that it wasn’t about power. He just didn’t want you to know that he had solved Royal Bloodlines. He didn’t trust you, he knew what you wanted but couldn’t give it to you.”

“Mere speculations.” Skykiller uttered coldly.

“No, I have evidence. When I pieced all the facts together, I arrived at a conclusion.” Li Qiye said.

“Which is?” Skykiller asked.
